value.rationale: Unlike arithmetic mean width, the geometric width mean responds to small directions. An exact all-profile majorization theorem in dimensions 2 and 3 and a sharp failure beginning in dimension 4 provide a dimension boundary and a new structural classification of a natural convex-geometric invariant; not a mere special-case numerical integration.
